mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, headers, is_default, created_at, updated_at FROM user_table_presets WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, name, headers, is_default, created_at, updated_at FROM user_table_presets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = true LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_table_presets (user_id, name, headers, is_default, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{headers, typeHandler=com.mapo.palantier.common.JsonbTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{isDefault}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_table_presets SET name = #{name}, headers = #{headers, typeHandler=com.mapo.palantier.common.JsonbTypeHandler}::jsonb, is_default = #{isDefault}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_table_presets SET is_default = false, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = true
